desc: A chain of edits keeps editing the same tile (bars, then dots, then blue).

json.reply: The data behind this project is 2 gold tables, each ready for dashboards: gold_investment_report_cash_daily (Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view.), with columns position_date, entity, view_type, cash_usd, status; gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly (Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value.), with columns report_month, entity, holding, net_worth_usd, net_worth_sgd, status. You can see 2 dashboards: Monthly investment report in USD and SGD, My dashboard. For the model underneath, how the tables are built and what feeds what, open Build and ask Span. To get a tile, name one of these figures: cash_usd, net_worth_sgd, net_worth_usd.
